Top 5 Movies of Barbra Streisand

Originally published 24 April 2023 · RewindZone Archive

Actor & Director ProfilesLists & Recommendations

Barbra Streisand is a name that needs no introduction. With a career spanning over six decades, she has become a cultural icon, known for her exceptional talent as a singer, actress, and director. Her contributions to the world of cinema are unparalleled, and her movies have left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. In this blog post, we'll take a closer look at some of the best movies of Barbra Streisand, showcasing her incredible range as an actress and her unmatched ability to captivate audiences on the big screen.

No.5 - "Hello, Dolly!" (1969)

"Hello, Dolly!" is a musical comedy based on the Broadway musical of the same name. Streisand plays Dolly Gallagher Levi, a widowed matchmaker who sets her sights on a wealthy merchant played by Walter Matthau. Streisand's performance is a delightful blend of humour, charm, and wit, as she brings the vivacious character of Dolly to life on screen. The movie features dazzling musical numbers and extravagant costumes, showcasing Streisand's incredible singing and dancing talents.

No.4 - "Yentl" (1983)

Advertisement

"Yentl" is a musical drama film that marks Streisand's directorial debut. She also stars as the titular character, Yentl Mendel, a young Jewish woman who defies societal norms by disguising herself as a man to pursue her passion for studying the Talmud. Streisand's performance is remarkable, as she portrays Yentl's struggle to find her identity and pursue her dreams in a male-dominated world. The movie is known for its beautiful music and touching story, earning Streisand critical acclaim and a Golden Globe for Best Director.

No.3 - "The Way We Were" (1973)

"The Way We Were" is a romantic drama that pairs Streisand with Robert Redford, creating an on-screen chemistry that is simply mesmerising. Streisand plays Katie Morosky, a political activist, and Redford plays Hubbell Gardiner, a carefree writer. The movie follows their tumultuous relationship over the years, capturing their love and the changing social and political landscape of the time. Streisand's performance is captivating, showcasing her ability to convey deep emotions and vulnerability on screen.

No.2- "A Star is Born" (1976)

In this romantic drama musical, Streisand plays Esther Hoffman, a young singer who rises to fame while struggling with the decline of her alcoholic husband, played by Kris Kristofferson. Streisand's performance is breathtaking, with her powerful vocals and emotional depth shining through. The movie's soundtrack, including hits like "Evergreen," earned Streisand an Academy Award for Best Original Song, solidifying her status as a legendary singer and actress.

No.1 - "Funny Girl" (1968)

"Funny Girl" is perhaps one of Barbra Streisand's most iconic roles, earning her an Academy Award for Best Actress. In this biographical musical drama, Streisand plays Fanny Brice, a legendary Broadway performer and comedienne. Her portrayal of Brice is both comedic and heartfelt, showcasing Streisand's incredible singing and acting abilities. The movie features memorable songs like "People" and "Don't Rain on My Parade," which have become timeless classics.

Barbra Streisand's filmography is filled with an impressive array of movies that have captivated audiences for decades. From her iconic roles in musicals like "Funny Girl" and "A Star is Born" to her powerful performances in dramas like "The Way We Were" and "Nuts," Streisand has proven time and again that she is a force to be reckoned with!
